sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module introduces the principles of visual aesthetics and how they are applied in the context of visual communication design. Moreover, the students will learn form a series of exercises to practice design methods and techniques in visual communication. The aim of the module is to establish a solid foundation in the students’ appreciation of visual aesthetics and basic design methods to achieve visually-attractive output. At the principle level, this fundamental module will have a broad impact on their subsequent learnings and practices in later creative modules. At the practical level, the learnt methods and design process will provide the structural guide and workflow to systematically plan and develop a visual communication project.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Understand the principles of visual aesthetics B. Understand the development process of visual communication design C. Apply visual communication design methods and techniques to produce creative visual design works
sections.Method of teaching and learning: - Lectures to deliver the background knowledge of visual design principles and methods - Tutorials to teach visual design techniques and guide the project development
